verdict.rationale: Render is a cloud deployment platform, so a direct folder-upload deploy is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence only describes repo-connected deploys ("Connect your repo and ship with every push"), Docker support, and per-PR preview environments. None of that shows uploading a folder of files without Git, or a deployment that stays private until explicitly published. A community commenter asking whether Render allows uploads is a question, not affirmative evidence.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy a project by uploading a folder of files directly, with no Git repo required and the new deployment kept private until I choose to publish it
